# `promote_cancel`

**Promote Cancel.** Close an unpublished promotion PR and abort its intent.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `promote_cancel` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
